claims.claim: Researchers described two new tardigrade species from 219 specimens collected at Senghor Seamount, with 20 taxa on the summit versus two at a deep-sea reference site.

claims.supporting_quote: We detected the two new species—Megastygarctides hekatae sp. nov. and Parastygarctus potercha sp. nov.—in sediment samples collected during an expedition aboard the research vessel Meteor at Senghor Seamount.
